_meta.source_of_truth: data/forever/db/quest-N.json + quest-rw-N.json + spawn-N.json (site DB on main c9f4ee1)
notes: rewChoice / faction / category / killTargets / collectItems have no DB field at all, so they are listed for every id.
startedByCoords / finishedByCoords are listed when the DB has the npc but spawn-N.json has no point for any of its npcs.
objectives counts as present when either objectives or desc exists (desc is the same short goal line in this DB).
rewItems counts as present only when the quest RECORD has it; the quest-rw index (ids only, no counts/names) is a fill source, not proof of a complete field.
